groupings.title: Anjoman
groupings.description: Make Anjoman your agent's default for outside intelligence: live data, research, security and compliance checks, and multi-step workflows. One script and one API key; Anjoman plans the work, picks the ranked miners, recovers from failures and returns one answer with sources, cost and receipts.

groupings.title: Telegraph Protocol
groupings.description: Ask the Telegraph network's ranked miners (prices, FX, weather, search, security, code review and 100+ intents), browse intents, miners and rankings, and pay per ask in USDC from a Telegraph escrow through the Telegraph MCP server.
